conclusions.text: The bounded corrected runner now rejects a 226-row crosswalk with only 225 unique subjects and admits a fresh whole-run destination before calculations; the positive/negative controls and exact pair report retain the actual row counts, unique IDs and missing subject.

For these exact 226 subjects, the reproduced candidate rows join through retained historical geoBoundaries features and Atlas parents to OCHA ADM3 candidates and their native ADM2/ADM1 parents. This establishes row-level source correspondence in the retained files, not legal boundary truth.

All 2486 archived numeric fields, 678 selected geodesic scores and 14 aggregate counts match the pinned prior packet; the separate exterior-minus-hole calculation matches all 678 scores to eight decimals. These checks reproduce prior measurements and do not resolve the source vintage or current administrative meaning.

The issue-reported 263846-byte duplicate fixture hash 3dba096bc814c323f99ccc5a86a5e7a4c977a58b1f7e85f6332f6088107e0818 is not reproduced because those exact bytes are unavailable. A distinct 318965-byte one-row-replacement fixture is retained with SHA-256 020107ea109be4d4e4f575e3863aa72d9cdbdd37561d64d1aa43133cfda9b71f and one precisely identified missing subject.

The OCHA COD-AB is described as an INC-attributed operational reference, with metadata marked fresh at the 2026-10-05 retrieval and annual update due 2026-10-30; the declared package coverage ends 2025-10-30 and source boundaries were created/last edited 1987-08-22. This does not establish legal national boundary authority or coordinate refresh after 1987.

The retained WRI/INC comparison layer reports 360 features while its metadata describes 359, all code_arr values are null, and the layer explicitly lacks legal validation; it is comparison evidence only.

Complete current legal ADM3 coverage, source authority and unrestricted current national boundary geometry remain unresolved. The prior Cameroon source audit remains Incomplete and its official-page/decree restoration instructions and separate #897 legal-source owner are not resolved by this erratum.

methods.description: Independently compute exterior-minus-hole positive WGS84 geodesic ring areas for each exact historical geoBoundaries subject and selected OCHA candidate, and compare IoU plus both directional coverage ratios at eight decimals to the archived result. Geometry uses Shapely/GEOS validity and ring handling; PyProj/PROJ supplies WGS84 Geod only. The configured PROJ data directory fails pyproj validation and no coordinate operation/grid is used.
